description: This file defines a LinkedList class implemented in Kotlin, providing typical linked list operations such as add, remove, size, and get, along with an internal Node class and utility methods.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: A custom linked list implementation supporting basic list operations.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an element to the end of the linked list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of the specified element from the list.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the element at the specified index.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Helper method to unlink a node from the list.

methods.name: tail
methods.description: Utility method to find the last node in the list.
